game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks, barracks half buried in snow: the firewood keeper must handle winter bandits while practicing functions. Core idea – Countdown Recursion: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case.
theme: Snowy Hold – Snowdrift Barracks: barracks half buried in snow
core_gameplay_loop: In Snowdrift Barracks, repeat each round: Use a simple self-calling function to count down to a base case. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the base_case value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the beacon fire using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: The beacon fire reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the beacon fire is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 7 (applied tier): Countdown Recursion
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how base_case changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against winter bandits in Snowdrift Barracks.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The beacon fire reached with actions_used <= 17.
